author: (A. Costa, 1867)

note.en: An aeolid slug of about 2 cm recorded from one specimen at 9 m beside the Punta Mona islet in 2001. The name is a Mediterranean one, so the identification needs checking.
note.es: Un nudibranquio eólido de unos 2 cm registrado en un ejemplar a 9 m junto al islote de Punta Mona en 2001. El nombre es mediterráneo, así que la identificación debe verificarse.

evidence: GBIF: 1 preserved specimen in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2001)
WoRMS lists it for the Costa Rican Caribbean

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón
